target.outcome: Daily SIH/SUS COVID-19 hospitalizations among São José dos Campos residents (ICD-10 B34.2)
target.pollutant: O3, NO2, and PM10; lag 0 through 7 days
target.geography: São José dos Campos, São Paulo, Brazil (municipality code 354990)

sources.role: SIH/SUS outcome microdata (first required monthly object; remaining URLs in decision log)

substitutions.reanalysis: Open-Meteo/CAMS gridded hourly fields at municipal coordinates, aggregated O3 daily maximum and NO2/PM10 daily mean
substitutions.reason: Independent public source required; no author exposure data used

substitutions.published: CETESB daily temperature and relative humidity
substitutions.reanalysis: Open-Meteo ERA5-Land daily maximum 2-m temperature and mean 2-m relative humidity

coverage.notes: No analysis panel: official raw SIH/SUS outcome object could not be retrieved; the independent air-quality response also contains complete pollutant values for 0/395 requested days.

blockers: Official DATASUS SIH/SUS raw outcome microdata request failed by connect timeout; without daily hospitalization counts, the specified negative-binomial model cannot be fit.
Open-Meteo air-quality endpoint returned hourly timestamps but null O3, NO2, and PM10 values for the requested historical period (0/395 complete daily observations); coverage was not relaxed.
